summary: Maintain ETA windows from a bounded set of terminal runs without refolding active work

replay.detail: Only relevant terminal transitions and terminal-run corrections or deletions dirty windows through keyed run lookups. Explicit dirty keys preserve unsampled removals; every affected window is cleared before rebuilding so sampled steps can move to earlier definition hashes or paths.

schema.detail: Add the member-local rebuildable local_run_eta_dirty key set and advance initialization to version 3. Candidates are limited in SQL to the newest 64 terminal runs per definition hash, ordered by first terminal-transition time and run subject, before selected-attempt claim bodies are loaded.

rules.detail: Unusable candidates consume the run bound but add no samples; confidence reports the true sample count and missing samples yield null. Work is bounded by 64 candidate runs per hash times those runs' own claims, never older step histories.

compatibility.detail: No wire fields, claim kinds or serving schemas change.

downtime.detail: Initialization runs during normal store opening without a destructive migration.

recovery.detail: Derived samples can be rebuilt from retained claims; original data is unchanged.
